en: "Oh, Momotaro, is it?"{KP}"Fohohoho...! I am the {bb}Time Bell Hermit{ww}!"{KP}"My {bb}Time Bell art{ww} is an art that swaps day and night!"{KP}"However, it can only be used in villages with long nights!"{KP}"Do you wish to learn this {bb}Time Bell art{ww}? There is a condition, though..."{KN}

"Then, in exchange for granting you this art, I'll have you do me a favor."{KP}"Lately my body has grown weak, so I've a hankering to drink the {bb}Water of Youth{ww}!"{KP}"I want you to bring me that {bb}Water of Youth{ww}!"{KP}"You should already know where the {bb}Water of Youth{ww} is!"{KP}"I'm counting on you, Momotaro!"

jp:
「ん！　必要に　なったら
　いつでも　来るがよい！」

「おお　桃太郎よ！
　{bb}若返りの泉水{ww}を　飲んだら
　元気が　出てきたわい！」{KP}
　
「礼を　言うぞ！」
　
　{KP}
「それと　{bb}ときかねの術{ww}は
　夜が長い村でしか　使えぬから
　気をつけるのぢゃぞ！」
en: "Oh, Momotaro! I drank the {bb}Water of Youth{ww}, and now I'm full of pep!"{KP}"You have my thanks!"{KP}"And remember, the {bb}Time Bell art{ww} only works in villages with long nights, so be careful!"

jp:
桃太郎は
{bb}{MM}{ww}を　わたした！

　{KP}

en: "Oh, Momotaro! You've done well to bring it!"{KP}"Fohohoho...! Now, I shall grant you the {bb}Time Bell art{ww}!"
